title: Insight Station — personal micro-tracker
content:
Purpose: tiny daily ledger for quick comparisons across micro-runs. Not formal; mostly shorthand, quick calculations, and hypotheses. Use this to decide whether to push a config to the shared runboard or discard.

Columns: Date,Trial,Model,Quant,SeqAvg,Batch,Threads,EffQPS,MedLatMs,P95Ms,TokCostPerK,Notes,Action
2026-02-16,T-302,gptq-7b-8bit,Q4,128,8,4,420,24,72,0.012,kv-cache on,look decent; try smaller batch for latency-sensitive route
2026-02-16,T-303,gptq-7b-8bit,Q4,320,16,4,360,45,130,0.0118,high tail; suspect bad batching distribution, profile queue
2026-02-17,T-304,redwood-v2-13b,FP16,256,4,8,95,78,210,0.034,good quality, expensive; test quantized fp16->int8 fallback
2026-02-17,T-305,redwood-v2-13b,int8,Q2,256,16,8,380,88,260,0.021,bursty but cost*latency trade OK, evaluate p95 SLA
2026-02-18,T-306,gptq-7b-8bit,Q4,64,4,2,610,14,36,0.013,very low seq -> great latency, consider route for short prompts
2026-02-18,T-307,redwood-small-3b,int8,Q3,128,8,4,260,29,84,0.0077,stable, try reducing threads to save cost
2026-02-18,T-308,gptq-7b-8bit,Q4,512,32,8,280,210,640,0.0095,very high p95, kv-cache ineffective for this workload

Quick notes and checks:
- EffQPS = observed successful responses per second during steady-state window (excl. startup).
- TokCostPerK approximate = (tokens_produced+tokens_input)/1000 * unit_pricing. I keep this rough for quick tradeoffs.
- Watch: p95 often driven by GC/eviction when KV cache size > 6GB on this node image. Need to test with cache_limit=4GB.
- Action shorthand: "roll" = push canary, "nop" = ignore, "probe" = add targeted profile run, "ship" = propose commit to runbook.

Hypotheses to test (short list):
- H1: reducing batch from 16->8 on redwood-v2-13b int8 will cut p95 by ~20% with <10% throughput loss. (probe)
- H2: enabling prefix-only KV caching for short prompts (seq<=80) can reduce median latency by 30% with minimal miss rate. (probe)
- H3: lowering threads from 8->4 on small models reduces tail due to less cross-thread contention under preempt. (probe)

Next run ideas (queue):
- R1: T-309 (2026-02-19): redwood-v2-13b,int8,seq=192,batch=8,threads=8, kv-cache limit=4GB -> measure p50/p95 and eviction counts.
- R2: T-310 (2026-02-19): gptq-7b-8bit,seq=64,batch=8,threads=2 -> short-prompt route candidate.
- R3: T-311 (2026-02-20): redwood-small-3b,int8,threads sweep 8/4/2, measure cost per 1k tokens and p95.

Scratch math (very rough):
- If T-305 cost per 1k tokens = $0.021 and we expect 10M tokens/mo -> monthly = $210.
- If switching to smaller model halves tokens processed (prefiltering at prompt layer) -> $105/mo saved but need to validate quality.

Open questions / todo:
- Which test infra image used for 16xx nodes? (check infra/run-ids) -> add linked artifact.
- Add quick script to extract eviction counts from agent logs; share with SRE.
- Sync with Lina on rollout windows before canary.

Notes to self: keep this very short. When something looks consistent over 3 runs, move to shared runboard and tag with hypothesis id.

End of ledger.
